# `array_join`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Concatenates the elements of the given array
using the delimiter and an optional string to replace nulls. If no value is set for
nullReplacement, any null value is filtered.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
array_join(array, delimiter[, nullReplacement])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- array_join, example 1
> SELECT array_join(array('hello', 'world'), ' ');
hello world
```

```sql
-- array_join, example 2
> SELECT array_join(array('hello', null ,'world'), ' ');
hello world
```

```sql
-- array_join, example 3
> SELECT array_join(array('hello', null ,'world'), ' ', ',');
hello , world
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.4.0.
